snippet.title: NTL - Steam Trailer !
snippet.description:
🚀 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4020810/NTL_No_Time_Left/

No Time Left is a tactical sci-fi roguelike where you command a capital ship at the edge of known space. Manage power, launch drones, and make impossible decisions as every jump takes you closer to the unknown—and closer to the end.

Featuring cinematic ship-to-ship combat, deep subsystem management, and an atmosphere of isolation and urgency, No Time Left challenges you to survive the journey… and face what’s waiting in the dark.
